title: 🔆🔅Baghdad, 17 October 2026– Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met and held talks with his Turkish counterpart, Hakan Fidan, in Baghdad on the sidelines of the 52nd Session of the Council of Foreign Ministers of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC).
text: 🔆🔅Baghdad, 17 October 2026– Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met and held talks with his Turkish counterpart, Hakan Fidan, in Baghdad on the sidelines of the 52nd Session of the Council of Foreign Ministers of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC).
